text:
Aisha: Quick check — I pulled field notes from three onboarding calls this week. Common threads: confusing API key step, docs search doesn't surface code snippets, and customers want per-route daily cost rollups. Short feature briefs below.
Dan: saw the same in support queue, +1 on sample app ask (webhook example). Also one reported a 401 on first auth attempt then success after regen.
Morgan: can you paste the briefs here? I'll slot into the prioritization matrix for next triage.
Aisha: Briefs: 1) API key UX — customers want a clearer first-run flow: inline SDK install, example request that works out of the box, and a clear error message when keys are invalid. 2) Docs search — fuzzy matching, preview code snippets, and tag-based filtering (chat, embeddings, billing). 3) Per-route cost visibility — daily aggregate and delta views in Console for top N routes. 4) Rate-limit/retry guidance — sample retry headers and recommended backoff code.
Dan: support log snippet that hit the 401: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"hi"}'``` customer saw 401 then rotated key and it worked. Suggest clearer error text and a link to rotate keys.
Morgan: priority suggestion: API key UX = P0 (blocks onboarding), Per-route cost = P0 (billing risk), Docs search = P2, Retry samples = P3. @product-review please confirm by EOD.
Riley-bot: New CS ticket created: CS-3142 — "Onboarding friction: API key and docs". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3142
Aisha: Also flagged a pattern: customers repeatedly ask for curated prompt templates for common workflows (summarization, extraction, rewrite). They want copy-paste examples.
Morgan: good call — let's create a tiny "prompt templates" library and ship as part of onboarding. Dan, can you draft 3 real-customer templates?
Dan: will do. Drafts: (1) Meeting summary: "TL;DR and 3 bullets". (2) Extract actions: output JSON array of {owner, action, due}. (3) Marketing rewrite: tone=concise, audience=developers. Posting in 10m.
Aisha: I'll assemble a 1-pager with customer quotes and severity notes and drop in the shared drive. Tagging: cs-product-inputs.
Morgan: thanks — once in drive I'll assign tickets and slot API-key UX and per-route costs into the next sprint planning.
Aisha: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
